Fact: data_acquisition
What to find: How training data was obtained and selected, including annotation and synthetic-data generation methods and how rights were obtained.
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Collection

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Pre-training data is a large-scale, diverse collection spanning web documents, code, mathematics and images (audio also listed), with a January 2025 cutoff; web text covers over 140 languages. Filtering applied: CSAM filtering, automated sensitive/personal data filtering, and content quality and safety filtering. The card does not describe annotation, synthetic data generation, or how rights were obtained.
quotes: Our pre-training dataset is a large-scale, diverse collection of data encompassing a wide range of domains and modalities, which includes web documents, code, images, audio, with a cutoff date of January 2025.

**Web Documents**: A diverse collection of web text ensures the model is exposed to a broad range of linguistic styles, topics, and vocabulary. The training dataset includes content in over 140 languages.
**CSAM Filtering**: Rigorous CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) filtering was applied at multiple stages in the data preparation process to ensure the exclusion of harmful and illegal content.
**Additional methods**: Filtering based on content quality and safety in line with [our policies](https://ai.google/static/documents/ai-responsibility-update-published-february-2025.pdf).
